title: Bix's last months, Casa Loma contract and death
summary: Stories of Bix's final months, the possible Casa Loma job, and getting up sick to play a job that led to pneumonia and death; also Davy Tough's death.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
